conclusions.claim: The unzipped project contains only one map, L_Overview.umap.
The map has a real landscape, foliage instances, sky atmosphere, skylight, directional light and volumetric clouds; its filename alone cannot establish a simple mesh-only overview.
All 64 cached terrain component boxes have local Z min=max=0; landscape root scale is 100 per axis and 8x8 components have 63 quads each (504m square under standard Unreal centimeter units).
conclusions.confidence: decoded properties; cached terrain metadata, not independently rendered heightmap

conclusions.claim: Both saved cameras are aerial (104.63m and 108.97m high) and look down at about -45.60 and -48.79 degrees, unlike the supplied ground-level Preview_1.jpg.
This is not evidence of the exact assembled Preview_1 glade. Reusing its assets and atmospheric settings is justified; importing this map as-is would not establish the requested shot.

limitations: No Unreal Editor runtime or rendered map comparison was performed.
The embedded heightmap texture pixels and foliage instance native payloads were not reconstructed.
Some tagged-property parsing does not cover every UE type; explicit parsed properties retain offsets, unresolved suffix/native data is not inferred.
Alternate engine archives were examined by parent separately; this evidence concerns the newly unzipped Unreal project only.
